# 1. Open dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(performance)
library(DHARMa)
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(lattice)
library(ggpubr)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(MuMIn)
select <- dplyr::select

agri <- read.csv("6.practices_plant_family/input/agro_data_per_field_and_year.csv") %>% 
  select(-X) %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.character(id_parcelle),
    id_uniq=paste(id_parcelle,year,sep="_"))

plants_year <- read.csv(file="6.practices_plant_family/input/dataset_plant_families.csv") %>% 
  select(-X) %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.character(id_parcelle),
    id_uniq=paste(id_parcelle,year,sep="_")) 

plant_agri <- plants_year %>% 
  left_join(agri) %>% 
  relocate(id_uniq)

overdisp_fun <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  Pearson.chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  prat <- Pearson.chisq / rdf
  pval <- pchisq(Pearson.chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)
  c(chisq = Pearson.chisq, ratio = prat, rdf = rdf, p = pval)
}
```

# 2. Remove NA

```{r}
plant_agri <- plant_agri %>% 
  select(1:15,TypeCulture,nbre_interv,CoefN,nbre_pesticides) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(nbre_pesticides),
         !is.na(nbre_interv),
         !is.na(CoefN)) %>% 
  group_by(id_parcelle) %>% 
  mutate(nbre_annee= n_distinct(year)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(nbre_annee>7) %>% # 201 fields only after removing NA and fields with less than 7 years of samples
  mutate(nbre_pesticides=scale(nbre_pesticides),
         nbre_interv=scale(nbre_interv),
         CoefN=scale(CoefN),
         nbre_pesticides=scale(nbre_pesticides))

plant_agri$year_c <- as.numeric(
  scale(plant_agri$year, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
)
  
summary(plant_agri)
```

# 3. Whole dataset

## 3.1. Poaceae

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(Poaceae ~ year + nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides +(1| id_parcelle) , data=plant_agri,family=nbinom1)

sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod,n = 1000)
plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res) # too much zero

mod2 <- glmmTMB(Poaceae ~ year + nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides + (1| id_parcelle) , data=plant_agri,family=nbinom1, ziformula = ~1)

sim_res_zi <- simulateResiduals(mod2)
testZeroInflation(sim_res_zi)
AIC(mod,mod2) # zero inflated model better
overdisp_fun(mod2)

summary(mod2)
Anova(mod2)
```

annee 0.01 \*\*\*

```{r}
testDispersion(sim_res)
```
```{r}
testZeroInflation(sim_res)
```
```{r}
overdisp_fun(mod)


summary(mod)
Anova(mod)
```

## 9.7. Geraniaceae

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(Geraniaceae ~ year + nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides + crop_type + (1| id_parcelle) , data=plant_agri,family=nbinom1)

sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod, n = 1000)
plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res) # too much zero

mod2 <- glmmTMB(Geraniaceae ~ year + nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides + crop_type + (1| id_parcelle) , data=plant_agri,family=nbinom1, ziformula = ~1)

sim_res_zi <- simulateResiduals(mod2)
testZeroInflation(sim_res_zi)
AIC(mod,mod2) # zero inflated model better
overdisp_fun(mod2)

summary(mod2)
Anova(mod2)
```

vignes 0.35 \*
